subject: physics
title: Measurements & Uncertainties Adventure 3: Propagating uncertainties
meta_desc: IBDP Physics — absolute and percentage uncertainty, propagation rules, error in derived quantities.
final_note: You learned add absolute uncertainties when summing, add % uncertainties when multiplying or dividing, multiply % by power for exponents.

concepts.def: Δx in same units as x

walkthroughs.body_html:
For y = a + b or y = a − b: Δy = Δa + Δb (add absolutes).

For y = a × b or y = a/b: Δy/y = Δa/a + Δb/b (add fractionals/percentages).

For y = aⁿ: Δy/y = n × Δa/a.

On graphs, error bars show Δ for each axis.

Draw best-fit line, then max-gradient and min-gradient lines that still pass through error bars.

Slope uncertainty = (m_max − m_min) / 2.

This is the gold-standard for IBDP IA Physics — examiners look for it.
